title: E-Verification Methods: Aadhaar OTP, Net Banking EVC, and Class 3 DSC
text: An e-filed Income Tax Return remains legally invalid until successfully verified. Taxpayers can choose from five official verification modes on the e-filing portal: 1. Aadhaar OTP (an OTP is sent to the mobile number registered in UIDAI records, valid for 10 minutes). 2. Electronic Verification Code (EVC) generated via pre-validated bank account or demat account with mobile number confirmation. 3. Net Banking authentication (logging into net banking and redirecting seamlessly to the e-filing portal). 4. Class 3 Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) using emSigner utility (mandatory for corporate returns under ITR-6, audited firms, and political parties). 5. Physical submission of signed ITR-V by speed post to CPC Bengaluru within 30 days.
